svg.text: Intelligent Analysis of Unknown Program Behavior
Declare the supported file types up front — each one needs a different detonation path
Runs before detonation — cheap, fast, and the only signal you get when a sample refuses to run
File type and static verdict choose the detonation profile; every run starts from a clean snapshot
Isolated Sandbox / VM / Container — the sensors live INSIDE this boundary
Monitoring Layer — choose one and commit
Hypervisor introspection (out-of-guest): stealthy, tamper-proof, harder to build
In-guest agent (API hooks / ETW): high fidelity, but visible to the sample
The sample believes its C2 is alive,
so protocol and beaconing show up.
Syscall tracing produces millions of events per run — sampling and back-pressure are design requirements
The verdict is produced here, by deterministic components — not by the language model downstream
Run Outcome State — recorded explicitly, never collapsed into “benign”
Completed · Timed out · Crashed on launch · No activity observed · Sandbox evasion suspected
Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — the samples that matter most are the quiet ones.
The model explains the evidence. It never adjudicates — the verdict arrived already decided from stage 6.
